description: This file implements a key store for managing credentials and cryptographic keys within the Notesnook project. It includes classes and functions for handling encryption, decryption, key wrapping, credential management, and storage interactions, supporting features like password and security key credentials, with considerations for security and platform support.

classes.name: KeyStore
classes.description: A class managing cryptographic credentials, keys, and storage, supporting operations like registration, activation, deactivation, unlocking, locking, and credential management with encryption and key wrapping.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the key store by setting up storage and loading credentials and secrets.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new credential without secret into the store.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Removes a credential from the store.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates a credential, possibly wrapping its key.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the key store with a credential, retrieving the cryptographic key.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the key store, resetting credentials and storing the key securely.

methods.name: relock
methods.description: Locks the key store, clearing the in-memory key.

methods.name: changeCredential
methods.description: Changes a credential, re-encrypting associated keys.

methods.name: verifyCredential
methods.description: Verifies if a credential's key can be decrypted.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Stores an encrypted value associated with a secret key.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts a stored secret value.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all credentials and secrets from storage.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Retrieves or generates the cryptographic key used for encryption.

methods.name: getCredentialKey
methods.description: Generates a storage key for a credential.
